name: Fort Bliss
tagline: Home of the 1st Armored Division and one of the Army's largest installations, in El Paso on the Texas-New Mexico border.
_note: Large Army post (El Paso, far West Texas; straddles into New Mexico). Facts verified from official sources (home.army.mil/bliss, William Beaumont AMC, fortblisshousing/Balfour Beatty, DeCA/AAFES, Wikipedia for corroborated headline facts). BAH MHA TX279 (El Paso) via the bah_rates single source of truth. El Paso is in the Mountain time zone (America/Denver). Corrected 2026-11-09 from the website-page research (Base Guides/page-builder/research/bliss-facts.md): housing brand is Fort Bliss Family Homes (managed by Balfour Beatty Communities), 4,227 homes; El Paso ISD runs all six on-post schools and ten districts support Bliss; gates from the official gate page; 2026 El Paso tax rates (Ysleta and Socorro ISD rates pending after failed Nov 3 rate elections). Removed unsourced claims (safer large city, over a million acres of training land, largest Exchange, newer homes in Far East). Medium-confidence flags: base coords (approx), representative off-base ZIP 79936 (El Paso east side).

sections.title: Mission & Identity
data: Fort Bliss is home of the 1st Armored Division (Old Ironsides) and one of the Army's largest installations, with about 1.3 million acres owned, used or leased across West Texas and southern New Mexico.

The 1st Armored Division officially uncased its colors at Fort Bliss on May 13, 2011, after moving from Germany. The post also hosts the 32d Army Air and Missile Defense Command, the Joint Modernization Command, William Beaumont Army Medical Center and the NCO Leadership Center of Excellence.

sections.title: Which School District and Tax Area? The El Paso Decision

data.subtitle: Texas has no state income tax, so the choice that shapes your budget is the school district and tax area your home sits in. Inside El Paso the 2026 property tax rates we could confirm add up to about 2.7 per $100 of value before exemptions, and more where a utility district applies.
intro: El Paso ISD runs all six schools on post, and ten school districts in all support Fort Bliss families, including Gadsden ISD in New Mexico. El Paso ISD was rated B (82) for 2025-26; Ysleta ISD B (88), Socorro ISD B (87) and Clint ISD B (86). Confirm the district for any address.

Voters rejected Ysleta and Socorro ISD's proposed 2026 tax rates on November 3, 2026 (unofficial results), so those districts' final rates will be lower than first set. Some subdivisions, including parts of Horizon City, also pay a utility district rate of 0.20 to 0.80 per $100, which can push the total above 3.

recommendations.advice: About 21 minutes from ZIP 79924 to William Beaumont Army Medical Center with no traffic; typical home $194,573 (Zillow, September 2026).

recommendations.who: East and Far East El Paso
recommendations.advice: About 20 to 24 minutes from ZIPs 79936 and 79938 with no traffic, on routes that use Montana Avenue and Loop 375, both under construction. Check for a utility district.

recommendations.who: Horizon City, Socorro and New Mexico
recommendations.advice: Horizon City and Socorro are about 32 minutes away; Chaparral, NM, about 34. New Mexico exempts active-duty pay from its income tax, but a spouse's job income may be taxed there.
Fort Bliss Family Homes, managed by Balfour Beatty Communities, has 4,227 homes and more under construction. Leasing: (915) 564-0795.

sections.title: Gates & Access
data: Open 24 hours: Buffalo Soldier (with a 24-hour visitor center, 915-568-3215), Cassidy, MSG Espinoza, MSG Peña and Silvestre Reyes (formerly Constitution).
Weekdays 5 a.m. to 9 p.m., closed weekends: Chaffee, Old Ironsides (also closed federal holidays) and SGT Duran. CSM Barreras Gate is closed until further notice.
Gate hours and visitor requirements change, so confirm the current details on the official Fort Bliss gate page before you go.

sections.title: On-Base Housing
data: On-post housing is Fort Bliss Family Homes, professionally managed by Balfour Beatty Communities. The Housing Division lists 4,227 homes and says more are under construction; select homes are also open to retirees, DoD civilians and the public.
Leasing: (915) 564-0795, 1991 Marshall Road. Report to the Housing Services Office (915-568-2898) before you rent, lease or buy off post.

source.label: Fort Bliss Housing Division (official); Fort Bliss Family Homes
DoD 2026 BAH Rates, MHA TX279 (El Paso)

sections.title: Schools
data: There are no DoD schools at Fort Bliss. The post sits inside El Paso ISD, which runs all six on-post schools: four elementary, one middle and one high school.

Ten districts support Fort Bliss families: El Paso, Socorro, Ysleta, Clint, Canutillo, Tornillo, Fabens, Anthony and San Elizario ISDs in Texas and Gadsden ISD in New Mexico. For 2025-26, El Paso ISD was rated B (82), Ysleta B (88), Socorro B (87), Clint B (86) and Canutillo C (78).
Your assigned schools depend on your address, so confirm the district with the School Liaison at (915) 569-5064.

intro: Whether to rent or buy is the biggest money decision of most PCS moves. In El Paso, property tax is a big part of the monthly cost of owning, so compare it by address.
rent: Your tour is short (about two years or less) or your orders feel uncertain.
You want time to learn the area before committing to a neighborhood.
You'd rather not gamble on resale timing when you PCS out.
Your BAH comfortably covers rent in the areas you'd consider.
buy: You expect to be here three or more years.
You want to use your VA loan and build equity instead of paying rent.
You have checked the tax rate and any utility district for that exact address.
You've found a neighborhood and commute you're confident about.
data.bottom_line: There is no universal right answer. On a home you live in, a $140,000 homestead exemption trims the school portion of the tax. Run your BAH against the rent and home prices above, weigh your tour length, and talk to a lender and an agent who work with military families before you commit.

intro: The first month at a new duty station is mostly logistics. Knocking these out early makes everything else easier.

steps.title: Line up temporary lodging
steps.text: Book on-base lodging or a short-term rental before you arrive. You can claim Temporary Lodging Expense (TLE) for a limited number of days while you house-hunt.

steps.title: In-process and update DEERS
steps.text: Report to your unit and finance, and make sure DEERS and ID cards are current for every family member so TRICARE and base access work.

steps.title: Start with the Housing Office
steps.text: Check on-base availability and get the housing office's read on off-base neighborhoods before you sign anything.

steps.title: Register your vehicle and sort access
steps.text: Handle base access and vehicle registration, and learn the visitor-pass process for guests. Bring your registration and insurance.

steps.title: Enroll the kids in school
steps.text: Contact the gaining district early (El Paso ISD on post; El Paso, Ysleta, Socorro, Clint, Canutillo or others off post) and bring records and immunizations. Socorro ISD starts its year earlier. School Liaison: (915) 569-5064.

steps.title: Set up healthcare
steps.text: Update your TRICARE enrollment so you can be seen at William Beaumont Army Medical Center or network providers.

data.a: The 1st Armored Division (Old Ironsides), the 32d Army Air and Missile Defense Command, the Joint Modernization Command and William Beaumont Army Medical Center, on one of the Army's largest installations by land area.
Buffalo Soldier, Cassidy, MSG Espinoza, MSG Peña and Silvestre Reyes (formerly Constitution). The Buffalo Soldier visitor center is open 24 hours.

data.q: Which school district serves families on post?
data.a: El Paso ISD runs all six on-post schools. Off post, the district depends on your address, so confirm it before you sign.
